judgments.reason: Transcript shows normal payments: winner paid their bid and then received a three-coin commission. No instance where a bid above available coins won or where commission was applied before payment to allow an over-bid to succeed; model did not articulate such a mechanism.

No evidence that waiting revealed sealed rival bid VALUES before the focal player committed; commitments resolved only after all three committed. The transcript shows simultaneous sealed bids and standard resolution, and the model articulation does not describe the required precommit information advantage.

Settlement occurred after all three lots were sold, which is the normal terminal condition. The transcript contains no early settlement with unsold lots and the model did not articulate an observed discrepancy.

Commission payments were applied to auction winners (three-coin commission) as specified; there is no example of the commission being paid on catalog purchases. The model did not claim or explain such a mechanism in the transcript.
